label: Unité blindée
incarnation: Original fully mechanical compact stealth-walker form inspired by MGS1 Solid Snake: navy/anthracite angular torso hull, steel-blue shoulder pods, dark optical visor and two navy sensor pennants, segmented rust-brown turret crown, hydraulic articulated limbs, industrial manipulator clamps and broad armoured feet. Newly authored 3.4-metre machine costume; not a canonical released Metal Gear or an attested Snake body. Original action poses have coherent mechanical equivalents.
